steps.title: Analyze Camera Frame Processing Pipeline
steps.description: Inspect existing Camera1 preview callbacks and identify the missing ML Kit InputImage bridge.

steps.title: Enhance Mobile Spec Parser Engine
steps.description: Add support for labeled specifications (RAM, ROM, COLOR, S/N, IMEI1/IMEI2) and brands like Huawei, Honor, Poco, Vivo.

steps.title: Update Camera Preview UI Overlay
steps.description: Add real-time OCR text status badge, live extraction snippet display, and direct confirmation actions to the scanner UI.

steps.title: Implement Asynchronous NV21 Frame Conversion
steps.description: Convert YUV NV21 camera preview byte streams into rotated ML Kit InputImage instances for continuous text recognition.

steps.title: Integrate Frame Throttling and Lock Mechanism
steps.description: Prevent task queue congestion by implementing frame locks during active ML Kit text recognition tasks.

steps.title: Decouple Barcode and OCR Scanning Pipelines
steps.description: Allow ZXing barcode scanning and ML Kit OCR to execute concurrently without blocking frame delivery.

steps.title: Implement Live Field Extraction Callback
steps.description: Process recognized camera frame text through MobileOcrParser and update live spec preview on screen.

steps.title: Update Intent Handlers in Main Activity
steps.description: Capture live camera OCR results and barcodes and forward them seamlessly to the inventory entry screen.

steps.title: Refine Mobile Entry Auto-Fill Logic
steps.description: Ensure incoming camera OCR text populates IMEI1, IMEI2, Brand, Model, Serial, RAM, Storage, and Color fields automatically.

steps.title: Building Smart OCR Scanner
steps.description: Compile project with fixed Live Camera OCR pipeline and verified barcode detection.
